questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of the wooden box: 20 cm × 12 cm × 10 cm

Thickness of wood: 1 cm

Volume of wood used = Outer Volume - Inner Volume

**Calculation:**

Outer dimensions: 20 cm × 12 cm × 10 cm

Outer Volume = 20 × 12 × 10

Outer Volume = 2400 cm³

Inner dimensions: (20 - 2) cm × (12 - 2) cm × (10 - 2) cm

Inner dimensions: 18 cm × 10 cm × 8 cm

Inner Volume = 18 × 10 × 8

Inner Volume = 1440 cm³

Volume of wood used = Outer Volume - Inner Volume

⇒ Volume of wood used = 2400 cm³ - 1440 cm³

⇒ Volume of wood used = 960 cm³

questions.question: Which modes of reproduction is used by unicellular organisms?

__
 
• Unicellular organisms primarily reproduce through a process known as **binary fission**, where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells.
 
• Binary fission is the most common mode of reproduction in prokaryotic organisms such as **bacteria**.
 
• In eukaryotic unicellular organisms, such as **amoebas and paramecia**, a similar process occurs but involves mitosis followed by cytokinesis.
 
• Fission allows for rapid population growth under favorable environmental conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Budding**

 
 
• Budding is a form of asexual reproduction where a new organism grows from a certain part of the parent organism.
 
• This method is commonly seen in **yeasts** (unicellular fungi) and some other organisms.
 
 
 
• **Regeneration**
 
 
• Regeneration is the process of renewal, restoration, and growth that makes genomes, cells, and organisms resilient to damage.
 
• While commonly seen in multicellular organisms like starfish, unicellular species utilize various asexual modes including fission and budding to ensure reproduction.
 
 
 
• **Other Modes of Asexual Reproduction**
 
 
• Apart from fission, other modes of asexual reproduction include **spore formation** and **fragmentation**.

Time = Distance / Speed.

Speed of the train in m/s = 125 × (5)/(18) = 34.72 m/s.

Speed of the man in m/s = 17 × (5)/(18) = 4.72 m/s.

Relative speed = 34.72 m/s - 4.72 m/s = 30 m/s.

Time taken to pass the man = Distance / Relative speed

= 228 m / 30 m/s = 7.6 seconds.

**The time taken to pass the man is 7.6 seconds.**

__
 
• **Meiosis and fertilization:**

 
 
• **Meiosis **is a type of cell division that occurs in the formation of gametes (sperm and egg cells).
 
• During meiosis, the chromosome number is reduced by half, leading to genetic diversity among the resulting gametes.
 
• **Fertilization** then involves the fusion of these gametes, combining genetic material from two different individuals.
 
• The combination of meiosis and fertilization results in offspring with unique combinations of genes, contributing significantly to genetic diversity.
 
• **Meiosis and fertilization are the two important features of sexual reproduction in higher organisms that create genetic diversity in offspring**.

• **Mitosis **is a process of cell division that results in two daughter cells with the same genetic information as the parent cell.
 
• While mitosis plays a crucial role in the **growth and repair of tissues, it does not contribute to genetic diversity**.
 
• Fertilization, on the other hand, involves the fusion of gametes (sperm and egg cells) and brings together genetic material from two parents.
 
• However, since mitosis does not involve the creation of genetically diverse offspring.
 
 
 
• **Mitosis and binary fission:**
 
 
• Mitosis, as mentioned earlier, is a process of cell division that results in genetically identical daughter cells.

• Both **mitosis and binary fission do not directly contribute to genetic diversity in offspring**.

• **​Conjugation **is a process of genetic exchange in some single-celled organisms, such as bacteria.
